frontend/.yarnrc uses the Yarn-1 CLI-flag form '--ignore-engines true' (note: not readable via 'yarn config get', which is expected behaviour for .yarnrc flags) — no parse errors from yarn 1.22.22.
HrdPortalPage.jsx is ~1169 lines — consider splitting PayslipsSection / PeriodPicker / PIN dialogs into separate modules (maintainability only, not a defect).
